premises.text: Existing smart lighting options are painful: wired switches need costly install and exclude renters, while smart bulbs require many units and force phone-only control
premises.evidence_span: Why is it that a product meant to make our lives simple and better is such a pain to deal with right out of the box?

premises.text: Switchmate magnetically snaps onto a standard light switch and mechanically flips it so users keep manual control and add phone control
premises.evidence_span: It uses two magnets on the back that snap right to the screws on your standard light switch. And it mechanically flips the switch up and down

premises.text: Hundreds of millions of US homes and about 1.2 billion light switches are addressable, including rentals and condos
premises.evidence_span: There's about 120 million homes in the United States alone, a third of them being rentals and condos

premises.text: Go-to-market moves from pre-order crowdfunding to online retail then brick-and-mortar
premises.evidence_span: launch a pre-order campaign. We're also working with a manufacturing partner that has experience building multiple hardware products. By the end of this year, we hope to deliver to online retail, such as Amazon, and through our own website. Then, in 2016, we hope to get into brick-and-mortar retailers

premises.text: An optional hub will serve as base station for Switchmate and future simple smart-home products
premises.evidence_span: we'll be providing an optional hub that will serve as the base station for SwitchMate and any other feature products

domains.name: home switch market and retail GTM

value.text: Simple smart lighting that anyone can install without electrician work or losing the physical switch
value.evidence_span: makes smart lighting extremely simple without dealing with any of these issues

secondary_value.text: Peace of mind from remote vacation lighting and approach automation
secondary_value.evidence_span: leave on vacation with some peace of mind
